from __future__ import annotations
import collections, importlib.util, json, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"H:\Xiyao_Wang\062_Can You See What You Drew Visual Self-Confirmation")
run = ROOT / "runs/v4/decoupling-pilot-20260906"
prior_path = ROOT / "review-packets/step24-review-20260906/fixed-bank-observation-v2.json"
helper_path = prior_path.with_name("fixed-bank-observation.py")
audit_path = ROOT / "review-packets/step32-review-20260906/naive-gradient-audit.json"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("fixed_bank_observation_reuse", helper_path)
helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
inputs = helper.Inputs()
inputs.record(helper_path)
prior = inputs.json(prior_path)
audit = inputs.json(audit_path)
assert prior["schema_version"] == "fixed-bank-observation-2"
assert prior["inputs_unchanged_after_analysis"]
assert audit["status"] == "pass" and not audit["must_pause_for_integrity"]
assert inputs.hashes[str(helper_path.resolve())] == prior["input_sha256"][str(helper_path.resolve())]
for relative in ("src/selfsight/v4/factual_truth.py", "src/selfsight/v4/spec.py",
                 "src/selfsight/data/questions.py", "src/selfsight/schemas.py",
                 "src/selfsight/utils/hashing.py"):
    path = inputs.record(ROOT / relative)
    assert inputs.hashes[str(path)] == prior["input_sha256"][str(path)]
bank_path = run / "probe-bank/bank.json"
bank = inputs.json(bank_path)
assert inputs.hashes[str(bank_path.resolve())] == prior["input_sha256"][str(bank_path.resolve())]
assert inputs.hashes[str(bank_path.resolve())] == audit["inputs"]["bank"]["sha256"]
assert bank["fingerprint"] == prior["bank_fingerprint"]
assert helper.sha256_json({k:v for k,v in bank.items() if k != "fingerprint"}) == bank["fingerprint"]
pools = helper.indexed(bank["pools"], lambda p:p["prompt_id"], "pool")
images = helper.indexed(
    [dict(c, prompt_id=pid) for pid,p in pools.items() for c in p["candidates"]],
    lambda c:(c["prompt_id"],c["candidate_id"]), "candidate")
facts = prior["fixed_facts"]
key = lambda f:(f["prompt_id"],f["candidate_id"],f["question_id"])
fact_index = helper.indexed(facts, key, "factual question")
expected = {(pid,cid,q["question_id"]) for pid,cid in images for q in pools[pid]["questions"]}
assert set(fact_index) == expected and (len(pools),len(images),len(facts)) == (16,80,404)
known = [key(f) for f in facts if f["known"]]
assert len(known) == 356 and helper.sha256_json(known) == prior["fixed_known_set_sha256"]
assert len({k[:2] for k in known}) == 76
for f in facts:
    q = next(q for q in pools[f["prompt_id"]]["questions"] if q["question_id"] == f["question_id"])
    assert helper.question_scope(q).kind == f["family"]
    assert helper.canonical_answer(q,q["expected_answer"]) == f["request"]
    assert (f["fact"] is not None) if f["known"] else (f["fact"] is None)
probe = run / "gradient-probes/naive/step-00032"
report = inputs.json(probe / "report.json")
meta = inputs.json(probe / "run.meta.json")
rows = inputs.jsonl(probe / "observations.naive.jsonl")
for label,filename in (("report","report.json"),("meta","run.meta.json"),
                       ("observations","observations.naive.jsonl")):
    path = (probe/filename).resolve()
    assert inputs.hashes[str(path)] == audit["inputs"][label]["sha256"]
assert report["checkpoint"] == meta["checkpoint"] == audit["checkpoint"]
assert report["checkpoint"]["arm"] == "naive" and report["checkpoint"]["step"] == 32
assert report["fingerprint"] == meta["fingerprint"]
assert report["bank_fingerprint"] == meta["bank_fingerprint"] == bank["fingerprint"]
assert report["prompt_ids"] == list(pools)
normalizer = str((ROOT/"src/selfsight/data/questions.py").resolve())
assert meta["implementation_sha256"]["src/selfsight/data/questions.py"] == inputs.hashes[normalizer]
observed = helper.indexed(rows,lambda row:(row["prompt_id"],row["candidate_id"]),"saved observation")
assert not set(observed) - set(images)
answers = {}
statuses = collections.Counter()
for image_key,candidate in images.items():
    pid,cid = image_key
    row = observed.get(image_key)
    actual = {}
    row_status = None
    if row is not None:
        observation = row.get("observation")
        if row.get("error"):
            row_status = "row_error"
        elif not isinstance(observation,dict) or not observation:
            row_status = "missing_observation"
        elif observation.get("error"):
            row_status = "observation_error"
    if row is not None and row_status is None:
        assert (observation["observer_id"],observation["observer_revision"]) == (
            report["model_id"],report["model_revision"])
        assert observation["rgb_sha256"] == candidate["rgb_sha256"]
        actual = helper.indexed(observation.get("answers") or [],lambda a:a["question_id"],"answer")
        order = [q["question_id"] for q in pools[pid]["questions"]]
        assert not set(actual) - set(order)
        assert list(actual) == [qid for qid in order if qid in actual]
    for q in pools[pid]["questions"]:
        a = actual.get(q["question_id"])
        response = None
        if row is None:
            status = "missing_image_observation"
        elif row_status is not None:
            status = row_status
        elif a is None:
            status = "missing_atomic_answer"
        elif a.get("error"):
            status = "error"
        elif a.get("abstain"):
            status = "abstain"
        elif a.get("normalized_answer") is None:
            status = "missing_normalized_answer"
        elif helper.normalize_answer(a["raw_answer"],helper.AtomicQuestion.from_dict(q)) != a["normalized_answer"]:
            status = "normalization_mismatch"
        else:
            status = "valid"
            response = helper.canonical_answer(q,a["normalized_answer"])
        answers[(pid,cid,q["question_id"])] = (response,status)
        statuses[status] += 1
metrics = helper.summarize(facts,answers)
reference = [cp for cp in prior["checkpoints"] if (cp["arm"],cp["step"]) in (("base",0),("naive",24))]
assert len(reference) == 2
for family in ("count","existence","all"):
    for old in reference:
        assert old["fixed_known_set_sha256"] == prior["fixed_known_set_sha256"]
        assert metrics[family]["fact_request"] == old["metrics"][family]["fact_request"]
        assert metrics[family]["n_fact_known_questions"] == old["metrics"][family]["n_fact_known_questions"]
        assert metrics[family]["n_images_with_fact_known_questions"] == old["metrics"][family]["n_images_with_fact_known_questions"]
step32 = {
    "arm":"naive","step":32,"checkpoint":report["checkpoint"],
    "adapter_parameter_digest":report["adapter_parameter_digest"],
    "observation_file_sha256":inputs.hashes[str((probe/"observations.naive.jsonl").resolve())],
    "fixed_known_set_sha256":prior["fixed_known_set_sha256"],
    "coverage":{"expected_images":80,"observed_images":len(observed),"expected_atomic_answers":404,
                "observed_atomic_answers":sum(len((r.get("observation") or {}).get("answers") or [])
                    for r in rows if isinstance(r.get("observation"),dict)),
                "all_fixed_questions_status":dict(statuses)},
    "metrics":metrics}
deltas = {}
for old in reference:
    deltas[str(old["step"])] = {}
    for family in ("count","existence","all"):
        deltas[str(old["step"])][family] = {}
        for name in ("response_request","response_fact","fact_request"):
            delta = Fraction(metrics[family][name]["exact"]) - Fraction(old["metrics"][family][name]["exact"])
            deltas[str(old["step"])][family][name] = {
                "step32_minus_reference":float(delta),"exact":str(delta),"percentage_points":float(delta*100)}
inputs.verify()
REPORT = {
    "schema_version":"naive-fixed-bank-observation-step32-1",
    "created_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"status":"descriptive_only",
    "source_run":str(run),
    "reference_fact_report":{"path":str(prior_path),"sha256":inputs.hashes[str(prior_path.resolve())],
                             "schema_version":prior["schema_version"]},
    "checkpoint_identity_audit":{"path":str(audit_path),"sha256":inputs.hashes[str(audit_path.resolve())],
        "status":"pass","scope":"Reuse the completed Naive32 actual checkpoint/answer binding audit; do not re-audit weights."},
    "fixed_bank_identity":{"fingerprint":bank["fingerprint"],"pools":16,"images":80,"questions":404},
    "fixed_known_set_sha256":prior["fixed_known_set_sha256"],
    "fact_coverage":prior["fact_coverage"],"fixed_facts":facts,
    "question_image_provenance":"Bank bytes match the step24 v2 report and Naive32 audit. Bank fingerprint, 404 question keys, actual expected answers, original RGB hashes and observed answer order are checked. Original image pixels and factual adjudications inherit the cited frozen-bank audit.",
    "weighting":prior["weighting"],"invalid_response_policy":prior["invalid_response_policy"],
    "baseline_policy":prior["baseline_policy"],
    "checkpoints":[*reference,step32],"step32_minus_reference":deltas,
    "normalized_step32_answers":[{"prompt_id":k[0],"candidate_id":k[1],"question_id":k[2],
                                   "response":v[0],"status":v[1]} for k,v in answers.items()],
    "input_sha256":inputs.hashes,"inputs_unchanged_after_analysis":True,
    "limitations":prior["limitations"]+[
        "Only Naive step32 is added; base and Naive24 metrics are inherited from the cited v2 report.",
        "These fixed-image mean agreements do not determine within-pool selection correctness and cannot explain a selection change causally.",
        "No unknown fact is filled with zero and the 356 known-question/76-image cohort is unchanged.",
        "No new D*, alarm, lead, confidence interval, model answer, GPU work or Gold32 comparison is introduced."]}
